# capture time

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:captureTime`](gmeow-captureTime.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/captureTime>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/documents`](../../slices/documents.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The date and time when the image or media was captured. Non-functional: competing capture-time claims from different sources or EXIF vs. metadata may coexist with confidence.

## Structure

**Property shape:** datatype property; [`gmeow:MediaObject`](../classes/gmeow-MediaObject.md) -> [`xsd:dateTime`](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for when an image or media was captured — the shutter/recording instant; non-functional, so competing EXIF-vs-metadata claims coexist with confidence.

### Avoid when

- Avoid conflating it with [`gmeow:datePublished`](gmeow-datePublished.md) (when the media was published) and avoid collapsing competing source times — keep it non-functional and index disputes with [`gmeow:accordingTo`](gmeow-accordingTo.md).

### How to use

- Carry the capture instant on [`gmeow:captureTime`](gmeow-captureTime.md) as [xsd:dateTime](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime); pair with [`gmeow:captureDevice`](gmeow-captureDevice.md) and carry conflicting claims as standpoint-indexed statements rather than choosing one.

### Examples

- ex:photo [`gmeow:captureTime`](gmeow-captureTime.md) "2019-07-04T18:23:00Z"^^[xsd:dateTime.](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#dateTime.)
